description.value: Caffe Artigiano (now branded as Artigiano) is a Vancouver-founded specialty coffee chain with over 25 locations across BC and Alberta, built on a reputation for latte art and internationally award-winning barista craft. The Main Street location offers indoor and outdoor seating, accepts credit and debit cards, and is wheelchair accessible. The chain roasts its own 100% Arabica beans at a Burnaby roastery and emphasizes organic, locally sourced ingredients in its house-made baked goods.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Artigiano (formerly Caffe Artigiano) is an active chain with a 'Main St' Vancouver location listed among current locations, supporting the OSM record. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags beyond general cafe features; takeout is supported by the website's 'Order Ahead' functionality.
